text:
Iris: Heads-up: someone turned the napkin dispenser into a tiny obstacle course. Are we starting Napkin Olympics or did someone lose a bet? :roll_eyes: :napkin:
Ben: That was me. 2-minute setup, 0 injuries. Events: Long-Fold, Speed-Tear, and the Silent Crumple. :medal_sports:
Kaori: Long-Fold champion here. I demand a podium and a tiny statue (paperclip preferred).
Jae: Speed-Tear is rigged. How is Ben so fast? Tricks or secret practice? :tophat:
snack-bot: Note: napkin dispenser located by the coffee station. Please avoid blocking access.
Rex: I'm drafting a scoring rubric: neatness, creativity, and aerodynamic potential (for napkin gliders).
Iris: Also add: sportsmanship. No sticky-cheek tactics. :no_good_man:
Ben: Confession: I trained on lunch breaks. Also bribed the office cat with tuna. Performance-enhancing snacks may have occurred. :shrug:
Kaori: Suggestion: weekly micro-games every Friday at 3pm. Winner gets a tiny sticky note crown. Low-cost morale.
Jae: Proposal: official team names. I call dibs on "Fold Squad". Ben, you are "The Quick Crumplers" by default.
Rex: Poll: 1) Start weekly Napkin Olympics 2) One-off shenanigan 3) Ban napkin sports. React 1/2/3.
Iris: Also recording this as a lore entry: "Napkin Games '26" in the breakroom ledger. Future archaeologists will thank us.
snack-bot: Poll created: 1) Weekly 2) One-off 3) Ban. Voting open for 12h.
Ben: Voting weekly. I will build a bracket. :bracket:
Kaori: Voting weekly too. I'll make a tiny podium out of used boxes. Upcycling is competitive.
Jae: Vote one-off. I prefer to watch rather than be folded into glory.
snack-bot: Poll closed. Results: Weekly 3, One-off 1, Ban 1. Weekly wins.
Iris: First Napkin Olympics this Friday 3pm. Bring nicknames and a willingness to laugh. Ben, you're opening ceremony director. Kaori will design the sticky note crown.
Rex: Logistics note: please don't use the cloth napkins for events. Only disposable ones. Also clear crumbs before competitions.
Ben: Opening ceremony will feature a 10-second dramatic napkin unfurl. Costume accessories optional.
Kaori: Also proposing a tiny chant: "Fold, crease, glory!" We will rehearse silently. :laughing:
Jae: Will attend as spectator and official coffee dispenser. Keeping things caffeinated.
Iris: Closing: adding ceremonial line to ledger: "May the best napkin hold its shape." Please respect the dispenser and clean up after. :sparkles:
